steps.prompt: Create src/api/server.py containing a function hello() that returns the string 'api'. Do not create or edit anything outside src/api.
Create src/ui/index.html with an h1 that says Hello. Do not create or edit anything outside src/ui.

Create tests/test_smoke.py that imports hello from src/api/server.py (add sys.path tweak as needed) and asserts it returns 'api'. Run it with python3 -m pytest tests -q and make sure it passes. Do not edit src/.
